title: Super Vanilla
description: This project adds a better look for many things!
body:
# this texture pack adds a better but vanilla look to many things like:
- the hotbar inventory 
- invincible offhand
- ore borders
- some new particles like the crit particle and the sweep attack particle 
- a little bit shorter swords for better visibility
- and smaller mace in hand
- better stone
- clearer weather
- low fire
  have fun playing whis this texture pack and enjoy the day!
